desc: Derive a compact DP state of the last B reachability values and the transition for advancing one good square.
Fast-forward through long consecutive-good segments using saturation for A < B and cyclic rotation for A = B.
Handle each bad interval by advancing through its preceding good gap, then forcing all positions in the interval to unreachable.
Account for the initial position 1 being reachable, and process the final good segment through N.
Implement stdin parsing and output `Yes` exactly when square N is reachable.
